Union Cabinet Passes Resolution Praising PM Modi's 25-Year Achievements

The Union Cabinet has adopted a resolution commending Prime Minister Narendra Modi for his achievements over the past 25 years, during which he served as both Prime Minister and Gujarat Chief Minister. The resolution specifically hails his accomplishments during this quarter-century period.
